minRoleToEdit.name: Minimum Role to Edit Runes
minRoleToEdit.hint: The lowest user role that can open rune pickers and assign runes. Roles at or above the selected level have access. For example, selecting Trusted also grants access to Assistant GM and GM. Defaults to Game Master only.

cacheInfo.name: Compendium Cache
cacheInfo.hint: Feats and spells are indexed from loaded compendiums on first use. Use the buttons below to manage the cache manually.

settings.cacheNotes: Feats and spells are indexed from loaded compendiums on first use each session. Clear empties the cache. Refresh clears and rebuilds from currently loaded compendiums.

automationMode.name: Rune Automation
automationMode.hint: Automatic resolves rune effects instantly. Manual posts a chat card for each effect (damage, movement, status, saving throws) so a GM or player applies it with a click, similar to how a normal dnd5e attack's damage sits in chat until applied.

narrateUntargeted.name: Describe untargeted rune attacks
narrateUntargeted.hint: When an attack with a runed weapon has nothing targeted, post a chat card describing what its runes would have done, with the dice already rolled, so the GM can apply it by hand. A natural 1 is never described.

description.ember-surge: On an Emberbrand crit, Ruinmark's AC crack applies to all attacks while the target burns and Forgebell calls all nearby allies forward at once.
description.rift-break: When Stonecleft lands, Sandgrasp triggers with no save and Mirageward shields the entire party from opportunity attacks for the round.
description.crystal-anchor: Undertow's pull triggers Sandhold automatically, dropping speed to zero, while Burntrace's disorientation extends to all ability checks.
description.blight-field: The Ashcloud follows the blighted target as they move. Anyone in the cloud loses cover and invisibility.
description.ironwall: Emberveil's push triggers Wardpulse with no save, and Forgeshield's AC bonus extends to all allies within {radius} {unit}.
description.morrains-resolve: Guardian's Rush becomes a free action. The defender rushes to protect allies without spending their reaction.

stonecleft.description: On a hit, the target makes a DC 13 Strength save or is pushed {die}×{pip} {unit} away and has their movement halved for 1 round. On a critical hit, they automatically fail the save.

mirageward.description: On a hit, the target loses the ability to make opportunity attacks until the start of your next turn.

emberbrand.description: On a critical hit, the target is branded with ember fire. Until the start of your next turn, allies who hit the target deal an extra {die} fire or radiant damage.

sandgrasp.description: On a hit, the target makes a DC 15 Strength save or their speed is reduced by {die}×{pip} {unit} until the end of their next turn.

ruinmark.description: On a hit, the target's armor is cracked. Their AC is reduced by 2 for {die} rounds. Any attacker benefits from this opening.

forgebell.description: On a hit, the rune rings like a forge bell. One ally within {radius} {unit} may use their reaction to move up to {die}×{pip} {unit} toward the target.

burntrace.description: On a hit, a scorched mark is left on the target. They suffer disadvantage on attack rolls for 1 round.

sandhold.description: On a hit, desert sand hardens around the target. Their movement speed is reduced by {die}×{pip} {unit} for 1 round.

ashcloud.description: On a hit, a cloud of rift ash erupts at the impact point. Creatures in the cloud must make a DC 14 Constitution save or be poisoned and take {die} poison damage.

undertow.description: On a hit, rift energy drags the target {die}×{pip} {unit} toward the impact point.

scorcheye.description: On a hit, the heat-haze clarity of the desert strips concealment. The target cannot benefit from cover or invisibility until the start of your next turn.

wasteblight.description: On a hit, rift corruption spreads through the target. While poisoned, creatures ending their turn adjacent to them must make a DC 13 Constitution save or become poisoned and take {die} poison damage.

emberveil.description: Grants a passive AC bonus based on runic rarity. When struck by a melee attack, the attacker is pushed {die}×{pip} {unit} directly away and cannot re-enter your space until the start of their next turn.

stonewarden.description: When the wearer drops below half HP, the rune flares and restores {die} HP. Once per combat.

vanguard.description: When an ally is struck by a melee attack, the wearer may use their reaction to move adjacent to that ally. The attacker suffers disadvantage on all attacks until the end of the round. Once per combat.

wardpulse.description: When struck by a melee attack, the attacker makes a DC 14 Constitution save or loses their bonus action until the end of their next turn. Once per round.

forgeshield.description: When struck by a melee attack, allies within {radius} {unit} of the wearer gain +2 AC for 2 rounds.

ashenmantle.description: When the wearer drops to or below half HP for the first time, they gain resistance to all damage types for 1 round and cannot be moved or knocked prone while the resistance is active. Once per rest.
